note: The candidate bytes after the first flag byte become the raw IPv6 datagram stored in the OpenThread message.
The API forwards the input-controlled message object into raw IPv6 transmission.
The IPv6 header fields, including destination and next-header, are read from the message.
The realm-local multicast destination selected by the input drives execution into MPL option insertion.
The hop-by-hop extension length derived from input must not exceed the IPv6 payload length before it is used as a copy length.
The unchecked hop-by-hop length is used to copy bytes inside the message, causing an out-of-bounds message access when it exceeds the actual payload.
